 Responsibilities

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**Founding Engineer** 




**Overview** 




 An early\-stage, venture\-backed AI startup is hiring a
 **Founding Engineer** 
 to help build the ad network for AI.
 



  





 The team is creating immersive, personalized ad experiences for consumer AI entertainment and character platforms, including playable ads, animated character ads, sponsored experiences, and ad units that feel native to AI companions rather than disruptive to users.
 



  





 This is a high\-impact founding role for someone who is deeply technical, highly self\-directed, and has a real track record of building outside of their day job. The ideal person is not just an engineer who completes assigned tickets, but someone who has shipped side projects, experimented with products, built systems from scratch, and can move quickly in ambiguous environments.
 



  





 This role sits across
 **backend engineering, ML, infrastructure, and product execution** 
 , with direct collaboration across the founding team.
 



  





**Location:** 
 San Francisco, CA, 5 days in\-person
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Experience:** 
 0–3 years
 



**Compensation:** 
 $160,000–$220,000 \+ meaningful equity
 



**Visa Sponsorship:** 
 Not available
 



  





**Responsibilities** 



* Build and ship backend systems across AI\-powered advertising, consumer product experiences, and infrastructure.
* Work across backend, ML, and traditional system design depending on what the team needs to ship.
* Own features end\-to\-end, from technical design through implementation and iteration.
* Help develop scalable systems for personalized, immersive ad experiences inside AI entertainment products.
* Collaborate directly with founders and early team members on product, engineering, and technical decisions.
* Move quickly in a fast\-paced startup environment where priorities can change and ownership matters.
* Contribute to early engineering culture as one of the first technical hires.
* Figure things out independently, communicate clearly, and ship high\-quality work without needing heavy structure.



  





**Qualifications** 



* 0–3 years of engineering experience, including exceptional recent graduates.
* Strong backend engineering foundation with comfort across systems, infrastructure, and ML\-adjacent work.
* Demonstrated track record of building outside of school or work, such as side projects, personal products, open\-source work, GitHub projects, startup projects, or technical experiments.
* High agency, high learning velocity, and the ability to ship fast in ambiguous environments.
* Comfortable working directly with founders and cross\-functional teammates.
* Able to communicate well with both technical and non\-technical people.
* Willing and able to work in\-person in San Francisco 5 days per week.
* Must already be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available.



  





**Strong Plus** 



* Experience or strong interest in recommendation systems, ranking, ad experiences, or marketplace\-style systems.
* PyTorch fluency or hands\-on ML implementation experience.
* Background at companies such as Roblox, Meta, Amazon, or similar consumer, ad\-tech, AI, or infrastructure\-focused environments.
* Strong side\-project portfolio that shows real building, not just coursework.
* Open\-source contributions or a notable GitHub presence.
* Experience shipping production systems, not just research prototypes.
* Interest in AI\-generated media, mobile entertainment, consumer AI products, or next\-generation advertising.



  





**Benefits** 



* $160,000–$220,000 base salary.
* Meaningful equity.
* Free lunch and dinner, including a $35 stipend through Uber Eats or DoorDash.
* Office gym.
* Direct working relationship with the founding team.
* High\-impact founding seat at an early company building infrastructure for the AI advertising ecosystem.



  





**Who This Is Best For:** 




 This role is best for someone early in their engineering career who has already shown unusual initiative through side projects, personal builds, startup work, open\-source contributions, or other evidence of shipping beyond a standard day job.
 



  





 The team is especially excited by engineers who are fast, curious, technical, product\-minded, and comfortable building across backend, ML, and systems without needing a perfectly defined roadmap.

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.
   

  

**Code that saves lives.**
 As a software developer at Epic, you’ll write software that impacts the lives of 325 million patients around the world. Working in your own office, surrounded by thousands of high\-caliber developers, you’ll use modern development methodologies and employ user\-centered design, analytics, and machine learning tools to drive innovation in healthcare. Using leading\-edge technologies and languages like JS, TS, and C\#, you’ll invent better ways to reduce medical errors, streamline record sharing between hospitals, and provide the quality of care a patient deserves. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/softwaredevelopment/.
   

  

**Write software for the most innovative health systems on the planet.**
 The top\-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.
   

  

**Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.**
 Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).
   

  

**More than just important work** 
 .
   

  

 Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant\-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four\-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.
   

  

 We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit\-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non\-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.
   

  

* Relocation to the Madison, WI area (Reimbursed)
* BS/BA or greater in Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field
* A history of academic excellence or professional success
* Eligible to work in the United States without visa sponsorship (persons with appropriate qualifications and eligible for TN status under NAFTA may apply)
* COVID\-19 vaccination

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Streaming Media
jobs.description:
**Responsibilities**
 About the Team:
   

 The Media Network team is building an industry\-leading real\-time media distributed system that plays a critical role in TikTok’s live streaming and RTC scenarios. Serving billions of users worldwide, our network is among the largest real\-time media networks globally. Join the Media Network team to work on large\-scale distributed systems and help deliver an exceptional real\-time media experience to TikTok users.
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

 \- Design and implement high\-performance, latency\-sensitive media servers.
   

 \- Optimize network efficiency for media delivery, balancing cost and quality.
   

 \- Design, implement, and optimize media protocols, while staying current with industry trends.
   

 \- Leverage AI technologies to enhance streaming media scenarios and improve the flexibility and performance of the Media Network.
   

 \- Design and build resilient, decoupled systems to minimize single points of failure and improve overall reliability.
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Minimum Qualifications
   

 \- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
   

 \- Hands\-on experience with streaming transport protocols such as RTP/RTCP, RTMP, DASH, and CMAF.
   

 \- Familiarity with audio and video codec standards, including OPUS, AAC, and H.264\.
   

 \- Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, including TCP/IP, NAT, IPv4/IPv6, routing protocols, and packet processing (e.g., iptables, deep packet inspection).
   

 \- Proficiency in at least one programming language: C, C\+\+, Java, Python, Rust, or Go.
   

  

 Preferred Qualifications
   

 \- Experience with CDN, multimedia systems, live streaming, or WebRTC.
   

 \- Experience building or operating large\-scale distributed systems.
   

  

**About TikTok**
 TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​
   

  

  

**Why Join Us**
 Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day.​
   

 We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
   

 ​
   

 Diversity \& Inclusion​
   

 TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​
   

  

  

**TikTok Accommodation**
 TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation, please reach out to us at https://tinyurl.com/RA\-request​
   

  

  

**Job Information**
 【For Pay Transparency】Compensation Description (Annually)
   

 The base salary range for this position in the selected city is $162000 \- $316800 annually.​
   

 Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​
   

 Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure).​
   

 The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice.​
   

 For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:​
   

 Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment:​
   

 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues;​
   

 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and​
   

 3\. Exercising sound judgment.​

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Middesk:**
 Middesk is building the data and intelligence infrastructure that helps businesses work together with confidence. We started by creating a comprehensive platform for understanding businesses, bringing together authoritative and proprietary data to help customers verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and manage risk throughout the customer lifecycle.
   

  

 Today, Middesk is used by more than 700 banks and fintechs, and in 2025 we verified more than 7 million companies. We've also expanded beyond business verification to help companies form, register, manage, and maintain their businesses, supporting more than 50,000 companies in setting up over 100,000 accounts required to hire employees, run payroll, and stay compliant.
   

  

 Middesk came out of Y Combinator, and is backed by Sequoia Capital, Accel, Insight Partners, and Canapi. We're proud to be named on the Forbes Fintech 50 and Best Startup Employers lists.
   

  

**About Middesk Engineering:**
 We believe "velocity" is the rate at which we effect realized value for our customers, not the rate at which we ship code. And this pushes us to center our work around customers; how will this change I'm about to make help our customers get jobs done?
   

  

 When we’re coding, we're making hundreds of micro\-decisions about user experience that add up. How can I communicate this exception to our customers in a manner that helps them understand what's happened and unblock themselves?
   

  

**About The Role:**
 Engineers have the freedom to create a lot of impact for our customers. The role requires high agency and comfort with change. It requires people who believe the interesting problems in Engineering are stack\-agnostic. It requires Engineers who believe that solving customer problems quickly is what matters first; building scalable systems matters when customer problems are scaling problems.
   

  

 We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF or NYC office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in\-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.
   

  

**What You'll Do:**
* Work in React, Redux, Ruby, Rails, Postgres, and potentially Scala, Python, and Go to solve problems for our customers.
* Dive into all layers of the stack; frontend, backend, API, data processors, etc.
* Jam with Product Managers, Designers, Ops, and other Engineers every day to shape the direction of our products.
* Share your knowledge with others in Engineering; people should get better at their craft because they work with you. Even if you’re early in your career, you have something to teach.
* Contribute to the psychological safety of your team. Software is built by groups of people, and good relationships matter.
* Help us interview and hire other Engineers.


**What We’re Looking For:**
* While we agree the interesting problems in Engineering are stack\-agnostic, we’d love it if you had experience with a couple of the languages in our stack (see the first point above). We’ve found that Engineers with prior stack experience usually ramp faster.
* You’ve worked for a high\-growth, venture\-backed startup before and are looking for a similar role. Or, you've founded a company and are looking to get back into it.
* You’ve been working as a professional Software Engineer for at least three or more years.
* You understand SaaS business fundamentals (e.g. annual contract value, customer acquisition cost, and annual\-recurring revenue) and can demonstrate how the work you’ve done influences these metrics.

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Sensor, SaO (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission\-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI\-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
   

  

******About The Role:******
 CrowdStrike Falcon is a two\-component security product. One component is the "Sensor" — a lightweight agent installed on endpoint systems that observes system activity, recognizes malicious behavior, provides on\-box prevention capability, and sends telemetry to the Falcon cloud. The cloud component aggregates Sensor telemetry across each customer's network, correlates malicious behavior across machines, and presents security teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.
   

  

 The Falcon Sensor runs on tens of millions of endpoints worldwide, across Windows, macOS and Linux, in both user mode and kernel mode. Engineering software at that depth and that scale is among the hardest problems in the industry, and CrowdStrike holds the Sensor to an exceptionally high standard of quality, performance and engineering rigor. Sustaining that standard requires a team with true mastery of what software does at runtime, at the lowest levels of the stack.
   

  

 That team is Sensor Performance and Reliability — CrowdStrike's team of debug engineers. Deep runtime analysis is our craft: postmortem memory dump analysis, disassembly and reverse engineering, and source\-level analysis, used to explain with precision and evidence how low\-level code behaves on real systems. It is one of the most technically demanding specialties in systems engineering, and very few organizations invest in it as a discipline in its own right. We do, because at our scale the answer to "what exactly happened, and why?" has to be exact rather than approximate.
   

  

 Our mandate goes further than answering that question well. We're chartered to turn what we learn from deep analysis into durable engineering improvements — strengthening diagnostics, tooling, validation coverage and development practices so that lessons generalize far beyond the investigation that produced them, and so that the next analysis is faster than the last. Our work makes the product stronger, and it raises the engineering capability of every team we work with.
   

  

 We are hiring an entry\-level engineer to join us in that mission. We do not expect you to arrive with deep Windows internals, assembly, or reverse engineering experience. Those are skills we will teach you, and you will learn them from engineers who operate at the top of this field. What we are looking for is a strong programmer with excellent problem\-solving instincts and genuine curiosity about how computers actually work underneath the abstractions — someone who is drawn to a hard, ambiguous problem rather than put off by it. If you are the kind of person who cannot leave a mystery alone until you understand it completely, this is an unusually good place to build a career.
   

  

****Location:****
 This is a hybrid role based out of one of the posted locations: Redmond, WA or Sunnyvale, CA, with a combination of in\-office and remote work.
   

  

******What You'll Do:******
* Analyze the runtime behavior of complex low\-level software across user mode and kernel mode on Windows, primarily through postmortem memory dump analysis in WinDbg.
* Work from raw memory, register state and disassembly to a precise, evidence\-backed account of what executing code did and why — and hold yourself to a high evidentiary bar in reaching it.
* Correlate your analysis with source code, applying reverse engineering and disassembly techniques where symbols, source or context are incomplete.
* Drive investigations to accurate, well\-reasoned conclusions rather than plausible\-sounding ones, and communicate confidence and uncertainty honestly.
* Partner with Sensor development teams to translate your findings into concrete, well\-designed engineering improvements.
* Generalize from individual investigations: recognize patterns, and champion improvements to tooling, diagnostics, automated validation and engineering practice that raise the reliability bar broadly rather than locally.
* Build and improve the tooling, automation and analysis techniques that make deep runtime analysis faster, more repeatable and more accessible — for our team and for Sensor engineers across the company.
* Write clearly and precisely for engineering, quality and leadership audiences. A first\-rate technical analysis is only as valuable as its reader's ability to act on it.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across multiple locations and timezones, including Sensor platform, detection and OS\-specialist teams.


******What You'll Need:******
* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Solid working knowledge of C and C\+\+, and the ability to read and reason about code you did not write.
* Good foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, and comfort working with incomplete information — much of this work involves reconstructing runtime behavior from partial evidence.
* Genuine curiosity about systems fundamentals: operating system internals, computer architecture, memory management, concurrency, compilers and assembly. You should want to learn these deeply.
* Persistence and intellectual honesty: the willingness to keep digging until you actually know the answer, and to say clearly when you don't yet.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to take ownership of your work and follow it through to resolution.
* Ability to communicate, collaborate, and work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


******Bonus Points:******
* Any exposure to debugging tools and techniques — WinDbg, GDB, LLDB, or similar — including as a hobby, in coursework, or in CTFs.
* Coursework, internships, or personal projects involving operating system internals, kernel or driver development, systems programming, or computer architecture.
* Familiarity with x86\-64 or ARM64 assembly and the ability to read disassembly.
* Exposure to reverse engineering, malware analysis, or vulnerability research.
* Experience with Windows internals specifically (processes, threads, virtual memory, synchronization, the Windows kernel and driver model).
* Scripting experience, particularly Python, for automation and analysis tooling.
* Interest in or experience with the security landscape.

jobs.title: Growth and Brand Engineer
jobs.description:
**About Tin Can**
 Tin Can is building a safer, simpler way for kids to connect — without smartphones. We're creating screen\-free, delightful devices and services that let families call the people who matter most, free from the noise of today's digital world.
   

  

 We're building a bold, authentic, nostalgic, and kinda quirky brand that resonates with folks who want something simpler \& better for their kids than the tech\-infused lives we're currently living (and who have a sense of humor about it). As we gear up to scale to millions of families, we're ready to bring on an engineer to help bring the brand to life and make it fun and easy for our customers to share Tin Can with the rest of the world.
   

  

**The Role**
 We're looking for our first Growth \& Brand Engineer — the person who builds how new families discover Tin Can and decide to bring one home.
   

  

 In practice, that means the storefront campaigns behind our product launches and our biggest seasonal moments. A referral program that lets the families who love us tell the families who haven't heard of us. The tooling that lets our growth marketers launch a landing page on their own in record time. The sites and sign\-up flows behind our brand campaigns. The launches that open Tin Can in new countries. And the occasional campaign moment that's far more than a web page, the kind of thing people screenshot and send to a friend.
   

  

 You'll be the engineer embedded with our growth and brand marketers, turning what they imagine into things families can actually experience — usually on a campaign timeline, where the launch date doesn't move. You'll work closely with the engineers who own our app, our devices, and our voice platform whenever your work reaches into theirs.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role with an unusually short feedback loop. You'll ship something on Tuesday and watch new families arrive because of it.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own our Shopify storefront for acquisition — build and ship the product launches and seasonal campaigns behind our biggest moments of the year
* Build the self\-serve tooling that puts you out of the page\-building business: components, templates, and guardrails so growth marketing can launch and iterate on landing pages without filing an engineering ticket
* Build our referral program into something families actually want to share — the invite moments, landing pages, account dashboard, and rewards layered on top of our referral platform, plus the identity and reward data underneath that makes attribution and fulfillment work
* Build the campaign moments that are more than a page — the bespoke, high\-effort experiences we build a few times a year and want people to remember
* Launch the web surfaces behind our brand work — campaign microsites, partner pages, and sign\-up flows for the stories and events we want families to be part of
* Build new ways for kids to bring their friends along, from brand\-led Hotlines to the sharing features that turn one Tin Can into two
* Help open new countries — the customer\-facing side of international expansion, so buying a Tin Can in a new market feels as considered as it does at home
* Instrument what you ship and keep it reliable — tested, monitored, and reversible, because a broken checkout during a campaign is a family who couldn't buy the thing they came for


**What We're Looking For**
* 4\+ years building and launching customer\-facing web applications, with real ownership of what you were responsible for
* Strong JavaScript/TypeScript and modern front\-end work, plus enough back\-end range to build and run an API (we're mostly TypeScript on AWS Lambda)
* Hands\-on Shopify experience — theme development in Liquid, checkout and subscription flows, apps and integrations, and the judgment for what belongs in the platform versus outside it
* You've built tools for non\-engineers and enjoyed it — you measure your success partly by how rarely people need you
* You've worked toward campaign deadlines and know how to ship something excellent when the launch date genuinely can't move
* You instrument what you build and can read the numbers honestly, including when they say your idea didn't work — you'll partner closely with the folks who own our experimentation platform rather than shipping blind
* A reliability mindset on revenue\-critical surfaces — you'd rather catch a broken checkout with an alert than with a customer email, and you think in terms of what's tested, monitored, and reversible
* Security\-aware around commerce, customer data, and third\-party integrations — you keep dependencies current and know what an unmaintained plugin can cost
* A genuine eye for craft and a love of the details — you can take brand and design direction and make it look right, and you'll notice when the spacing and type are off before anyone files a bug
* A clear communicator who writes things down, because you want the whole team to understand the systems you build
* A collaborative, low\-ego approach — everyone here sweeps the floor
* Bonus: you've integrated a referral, affiliate, or loyalty platform via its APIs and SDKs — not just installed an app — and know where the real work hides in identity, attribution, and reward fulfillment; Flutter (our app is Flutter, and some of this work reaches into it); internationalization and multi\-market storefronts; feature\-flag platforms like GrowthBook; Klaviyo or other lifecycle\-marketing tooling; or having grown a direct\-to\-consumer brand through real seasonal peaks


**Why Join Tin Can**
* We're building tech that protects childhood: We're on a quest to give kids a more analog childhood — one with real conversations, real connection, and way less screen time. No doomscrolling, data mining, or dopamine traps — just a simpler, better way for kids to stay in touch. This is a rare opportunity to build something that truly matters.
* You'll own how the world meets us: This is the first engineering role dedicated entirely to growth and brand. You'll own how new families discover Tin Can — with the full backing of the founding team, and the autonomy to decide how those surfaces should work.
* Your work is visible: We're a small team, which means the page you ship, the referral loop you launch, and the campaign you launch are things the whole company sees and feels — often in the same week.
* Small, high\-trust team: Every company says "team," but at Tin Can it means something different. We're a small, mission\-driven group that genuinely has each other's backs — professionally and personally. You'll be joining a tight\-knit crew where your ideas and instincts matter from day one.
* Room to explore, not just execute: You'll have the space to challenge assumptions, solve hard problems, and build systems that reflect our values of trust, simplicity, and care.


 If you're excited by the idea of building the first thing thousands of families see — and being the reason thousands more find us — we'd love to meet you.
   

  

 Compensation Range: $145K \- $175K

What we are looking for is a strong programmer with excellent problem\-solving instincts and genuine curiosity about how computers actually work underneath the abstractions — someone who is drawn to a hard, ambiguous problem rather than put off by it. If you are the kind of person who cannot leave a mystery alone until you understand it completely, this is an unusually good place to build a career.
   

  

****Location:****
 This is a hybrid role based out of one of the posted locations: Redmond, WA or Sunnyvale, CA, with a combination of in\-office and remote work.
   

  

******What You'll Do:******
* Analyze the runtime behavior of complex low\-level software across user mode and kernel mode on Windows, primarily through postmortem memory dump analysis in WinDbg.
* Work from raw memory, register state and disassembly to a precise, evidence\-backed account of what executing code did and why — and hold yourself to a high evidentiary bar in reaching it.
* Correlate your analysis with source code, applying reverse engineering and disassembly techniques where symbols, source or context are incomplete.
* Drive investigations to accurate, well\-reasoned conclusions rather than plausible\-sounding ones, and communicate confidence and uncertainty honestly.
* Partner with Sensor development teams to translate your findings into concrete, well\-designed engineering improvements.
* Generalize from individual investigations: recognize patterns, and champion improvements to tooling, diagnostics, automated validation and engineering practice that raise the reliability bar broadly rather than locally.
* Build and improve the tooling, automation and analysis techniques that make deep runtime analysis faster, more repeatable and more accessible — for our team and for Sensor engineers across the company.
* Write clearly and precisely for engineering, quality and leadership audiences. A first\-rate technical analysis is only as valuable as its reader's ability to act on it.
* Collaborate with engineering teams across multiple locations and timezones, including Sensor platform, detection and OS\-specialist teams.


******What You'll Need:******
* BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
* Solid working knowledge of C and C\+\+, and the ability to read and reason about code you did not write.
* Good foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, and comfort working with incomplete information — much of this work involves reconstructing runtime behavior from partial evidence.
* Genuine curiosity about systems fundamentals: operating system internals, computer architecture, memory management, concurrency, compilers and assembly. You should want to learn these deeply.
* Persistence and intellectual honesty: the willingness to keep digging until you actually know the answer, and to say clearly when you don't yet.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to take ownership of your work and follow it through to resolution.
* Ability to communicate, collaborate, and work effectively in a globally distributed team.
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.


******Bonus Points:******
* Any exposure to debugging tools and techniques — WinDbg, GDB, LLDB, or similar — including as a hobby, in coursework, or in CTFs.
* Coursework, internships, or personal projects involving operating system internals, kernel or driver development, systems programming, or computer architecture.
* Familiarity with x86\-64 or ARM64 assembly and the ability to read disassembly.
* Exposure to reverse engineering, malware analysis, or vulnerability research.
* Experience with Windows internals specifically (processes, threads, virtual memory, synchronization, the Windows kernel and driver model).
* Scripting experience, particularly Python, for automation and analysis tooling.
* Interest in or experience with the security landscape.

jobs.description:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Product Engineer (Full\-Stack)
   

  

**Salary**
 $90k\-$140k \+ Equity
   

  

**Company Description**
 River is a $2M pre\-seed startup backed by the founders of Ramp, Kalshi, and JumpCloud building AI voice agents for B2B sales. Their technology conducts real\-time qualification calls, demos products by live\-controlling browsers, and manages automated follow\-ups to close deals for sales teams.
   

  

**Job Description**
 River is a $2M pre\-seed startup backed by the founders of Ramp and Kalshi building AI voice agents for B2B sales. As a Product Engineer, you will build real\-time services, LLM workflows, and browser\-automation agents. Working directly with founders in New York, you'll ship daily to production for our first customers.
   

  

**Location**
 New York, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Work at the bleeding edge of AI, building agents that don't just talk but navigate software live via browser automation.
* High\-velocity environment with direct founder collaboration, shipping code to production almost every single day to serve active customers.
* Backed by elite founders from Ramp, Kalshi, and JumpCloud, offering significant equity and a trajectory\-focused career path.


**What You Will Do**
* Build and optimize the backend services behind live voice calls, including session state management, integrations, and data pipelines.
* Develop and refine the browser\-use agent that performs live product demos and the automated prospect enrichment pipeline.
* Architect and implement LLM\-powered workflows to handle complex sales qualification and real\-time prospect interactions.


**The ideal candidate**
* 1\-3\+ years of experience shipping production\-grade software in TypeScript/Node, with a strong focus on backend systems and APIs.
* Proven track record of building functional applications using LLM APIs and a solid comfort level working across the React stack.
* Currently based in New York and thrives in a high\-intensity, in\-person office culture with a builder’s mindset.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

 Full\-Time

 $160,000–$220,000 \+ meaningful equity

 Not available

**Job Description**
 About the Team
   

  

 The AV Logging and Data Recording team within GM’s Autonomous Vehicle Platform Core organization builds the embedded vehicle software that turns real\-world driving into high\-quality training data for autonomous driving.
   

  

 Our systems collect the sensor, vehicle, and scenario data that AV teams use to improve perception, prediction, planning, and other artificial intelligence capabilities. We focus on capturing the right data from the fleet, preserving privacy, maintaining data quality, and reliably moving vehicle data into the AI development pipeline.
   

  

 We build the software that helps autonomous vehicles learn from the real world.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a Software Engineer on the AV Data Recording team, you will help build embedded vehicle software that enables fleet\-scale data collection for artificial intelligence development. Your work will support how GM autonomous vehicles capture meaningful real\-world driving data, validate its quality, enforce privacy requirements, and deliver it for model training, evaluation, debugging, and continuous improvement.
   

  

 You will work on software running on automotive edge platforms and collaborate closely with artificial intelligence, backend, embedded platform, and system development engineering teams to turn real\-world driving into high\-quality data for autonomous driving development.
   

  

 This is an early\-career / new graduate role designed for candidates who have recently completed, or will complete, their Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree before joining GM. You will be paired with experienced engineers to ramp up on AV software, embedded systems, real\-time operating systems, vehicle data pipelines, and the production engineering practices required to support autonomous driving at fleet scale.
   

  

 What You’ll Be Doing
   

  

* Develop embedded vehicle software that collects high\-value data for autonomous driving AI learning.
* Build components that capture, filter, validate, package, and offload vehicle and sensor data from the fleet.

* Build embedded software that controls how high\-value driving data is captured, monitored, and delivered from vehicle compute platforms.
* Debug complex issues across Linux and QNX\-based vehicle software, real\-time data recording pipelines, and backend integration points.
* Collaborate with AI, backend, embedded platform, and system development engineering teams to ensure collected data meets autonomous driving development needs.

* Experience with embedded Linux, QNX, automotive systems, robotics platforms, or edge compute devices.

Recognized as the No. 1 site trusted by real estate professionals, Realtor.com® has been at the forefront of online real estate for over 25 years, connecting buyers, sellers, and renters with trusted insights and expert guidance to find their perfect home. Through its robust suite of tools, Realtor.com® not only makes a significant impact on the real estate industry at large, but for consumers, navigating the biggest purchase they will make in their life, by providing a user experience that is easy to use, easy to understand, and most of all, easy to make decisions.
 



  





 Join us on our mission to empower more people to find their way home by breaking barriers to entry, making the right connections, and building confidence through expert guidance.
 



  





 At Realtor, our technology team participates in the research and development of scalable applications, identifying new technologies and trends to enhance our products and business. We build innovative solutions to help customers in their buying, renting, and selling journeys by connecting them with real estate agents and partners. We provide real estate agents and teams with best\-in\-class tools to manage their listings and grow their businesses. Join us to push the boundaries of what’s possible and learn from world\-class talent that promotes a culture of experimentation and learning.
 



  





 We believe in leveraging the best tools to solve problems faster. You will be expected to utilize AI coding assistants and LLMs proficiently to accelerate development velocity, generate boilerplate, and troubleshoot complex debugging scenarios. Beyond simple usage, this role requires critical judgment to verify AI\-generated outputs for security, performance, and accuracy. You should be comfortable integrating AI tooling into your daily workflow to eliminate repetitive tasks, allowing you to focus on high\-impact architectural and strategic engineering challenges.
 



  





**Three reasons to apply:** 



* **Your code will matter on day one \-** 
 You won’t be working on side projects or throwaway features. Your work will ship to products used by real estate agents and consumers across the country.
* **You’ll level up fast with real mentorship \-** 
 You’ll learn from Staff and Senior Engineers who care about clean code, thoughtful design, and helping you grow \- not just closing tickets.
* **You’ll build real systems, not just features \-** 
 From APIs and backend services to dashboards and lead delivery systems, you’ll work on modern, scalable technology that solves real business problems.

* **Seller Services \-** 
 Build the core systems that help real estate agents do their daily work. You’ll contribute to agent dashboards, lead delivery, and tools that help agents manage listings, clients, and grow their business \- all with support from experienced engineers.
* **Branding \& Promotions \-** 
 Help build products that allow agents to promote their listings and reach more sellers. You’ll work on customer\-facing features, backend services, and experiments around pricing and packaging that directly support revenue and customer success.
* **Lead Services** 
 creates technology that helps people connect with real estate professionals as they search for a home. As a junior engineer, you’ll work on features that improve how customers are matched with the right partners, helping drive business goals while learning and growing your technical skills.
* **Agent Branding** 
 \- Build systems to help agents differentiate themselves from the crowd. You'll contribute to portals that allow our clients to configure their brand, report on their branding performance, and provide insights on how to improve their branding presence. Additionally, you will contribute to the systems that expose our clients' brand across realtor.com.



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Participate in system architecture and design review
* Develop solutions that are of high quality, scalable, and reliable
* Work collaboratively in squads composed of Product Managers, Designers, Analysts, and Engineers.
* Investigate and prototype technologies that can be leveraged to introduce innovations
* Be self\-directed, take initiative, and drive towards solutions with guidance



  





**What you’ll bring** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* 2\+ years of experience in software development
* Experience in software development and a strong willingness to learn our technology stack, including: Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, NumPy, Pandas), React, Node.js, and GraphQL
* Experience working with relational or non\-relational databases.
* Experience with AI, Machine Learning, and AWS knowledge preferred
* Experience delivering high value to customers quickly and frequently, with regular feedback and support
* Experience evaluating trade\-offs between design approaches
* Software engineering best practices (e.g., testing, code reviews, documentation).
* Experience in developing scalable systems



  





**How We Work:** 




 We balance creativity and innovation on a foundation of in\-person collaboration. Our employees work three days in our Austin headquarters, where they have the opportunity to collaborate in\-person, adding richness to our culture and knitting us closer together.
 



  





**How we Reward you:** 




 Realtor.com is committed to investing in the health and well\-being of our employees and their families. Our benefits programs include, but are not limited to:
 


* Inclusive and Competitive medical, Rx, dental, and vision coverage
* Family forming benefits
* 13 Paid Holidays

* Immediate eligibility into Company 401(k) plan with 3\.5% company match
* Tuition Reimbursement program for degreed and non\-degreed programs
* 1:1 personalized Financial Planning Sessions
* Student Debt Retirement Savings Match program

 Do the best work of your life at Realtor.com®
 



 Here, you’ll partner with a diverse team of experts as you use leading\-edge tech to empower everyone to meet a crucial goal: finding their way home. And you’ll find your way home too. At Realtor.com®, you’ll bring your full self to work as you innovate with speed, serve our consumers, and champion your teammates. jobs.description:
**Company Description** 
 Helm is a flight simulator platform designed for strategic decision making, enabling organizations to test and understand complex scenarios before acting. Our agentic simulations model population\-scale human behavior as dynamic chain reactions, showing how decisions propagate across networks. Helm captures how customer actions, corporate responses, and regulatory changes trigger cascading reactions at multiple levels. This approach helps teams anticipate outcomes, reduce risk, and make informed choices in fast\-changing environments. Helm values rigorous engineering, thoughtful design, and collaborative problem\-solving.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Software Engineer role based in Bellevue, WA. The Software Engineer will design, implement, and maintain backend services that power Helm’s simulation platform, focusing on performance, scalability, and reliability. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include writing clean, testable code, reviewing peer code, and collaborating with product and research teams to translate complex behavioral models into robust software systems. The role also involves integrating data sources, optimizing algorithms, troubleshooting production issues, and contributing to architectural decisions. The Software Engineer will participate in iterative development processes, documentation, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong foundation in Computer Science, including data structures, algorithms, and software architecture principles.
* Hands\-on experience in Software Development and Programming, with proficiency in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, Java, C\+\+, or Go).
* Knowledge of Back\-End Web Development, including APIs, microservices, and working with databases and cloud\-based infrastructure.
* Competence in Object\-Oriented Programming (OOP) and familiarity with design patterns and maintainable code practices.
* Relevant bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Ability to work collaboratively in an on\-site team environment, communicate clearly, and participate in cross\-functional projects.
* Experience with distributed systems, simulation platforms, or modeling complex workflows is a plus.
* Comfort with version control, testing frameworks, and agile development methodologies.

jobs.title: Associate AI Builder
jobs.description:
**About Artera**
**Our Mission:** 
 Make healthcare \#1 in customer service.
   

  

**What We Deliver:** 
 Artera is an agentic company strengthening how healthcare providers communicate and care for patients. As an agentic partner, we bring over a decade of healthcare experience to address urgent workflows from day one and build custom solutions as healthcare providers’ needs evolve. Trusted by 1,000\+ specialties, FQHCs, health systems, and federal agencies, Artera strengthens and protects and enhances patient relationships across every interaction \- from intake and scheduling to referral management, post\-visit care, and more.
   

  

 Hear from our CEO , Guillaume de Zwirek, about why we are standing at the edge of the biggest technological shift in healthcare’s history!
   

  

**Our award\-winning culture:** 
 Our award\-winning culture: Since founding in 2015, Artera has consistently been recognized for its innovative technology, business growth, and named a top place to work. Examples of these accolades include: Inc.
 **5000 Fastest Growing Private Companies** 
 (2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024\);
 **Deloitte Technology Fast 500** 
 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025\);
 **Built In Best Companies to Work For** 
 (2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026\). Artera has also been recognized by Forbes as one of “America’s Best Startup Employers,” Newsweek as one of the “World’s Best Digital Health Companies,” and named one of the top “44 Startups to Bet your Career on in 2024” by Business Insider.
   

  

 Applicants must be currently authorized and have the ability to provide proof of full\-time, long\-term authorization to work in the United States. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa transfers now or in the future.
   

  

**About The Opportunity**
 Artera is hiring an
 **Associate** 
**AI Builder** 
 to build the agentic systems that deliver exceptional patient experiences for our customers — scheduling, referral coordination, medication refills, billing, payment estimation and more.
   

  

 You'll be a contributing builder inside a customer\-facing squad bringing AI\-native fluency in delivering end\-to\-end on your customers’ needs — owning initiatives from customer discovery through production operation, onboarding new customers onto what you build, and shipping enhancements that keep pace with the technical possibilities for a named subset of our provider customers. Your creativity should be boundless, your desire to deliver world class solutions unmatched, and your initiative and accountability to those outcomes as a new bar for our customers they themselves aspire to.
   

  

 At this level, you'll support/own customer outcomes independently with supervision, bringing the curiosity of a product manager, the discipline of a project manager, and the agentic fluency of an engineer to your work. You'll develop real subject\-matter expertise and long term relationships with senior healthcare executives, and internally teach and support newer builders and experiment and advocate for novel agentic techniques that make every Artera customer even more successful.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Ownership: Own end\-to\-end delivery and realized outcomes for named customers. Represent Artera credibly in customer conversations, and raise the bar on the customer solutions the squad ships.
* Strategy: Identify customer pain and create a roadmap for solving their problems.
* Program Management: Align stakeholders, connect necessary data pipelines, and manage fast and painless onboarding onto our solutions.
* Agentic Development: Build novel solutions for named customers; translate their operational reality into technical solutions that you yourself architect and code with our internal agentic systems.
* Continuous Improvement: Instrument, monitor, and improve the reliability of what you ship; create enhancements based on what production actually tells you; participate in on\-call where applicable.
* AI\-native: your work across all dimensions will be inherently reliant on AI\-native tools primarily using the CLI; which means you will own a greater breadth and volume of responsibility than a typical technologist.
* Domain Expertise: Develop and maintain subject\-matter expertise in your customer segments (e.g. primary care, community health, orthopedics) and integration surface (e.g., scheduling, referrals, patient messaging, EHR/CCaaS).
* Mentorship: Mentor and onboard newer builders; review their work with a mindset for raising the bar on agentic techniques and customer orientation.
* Leadership: Contribute to squad\-level prioritization and planning in partnership with the Head of Segment.


**Requirements**
* 0 \- 3 years of professional software engineering, data science, machine learning, product management, product design, or technical project management experience, or equivalent demonstrated output; open to fresh graduates!
* AI\-native fluency with measurable leverage — ability to produce output on par with multiple traditional engineers using AI\-native tools (e.g., Claude Code in the terminal) as the primary working environment; ability to learn new technology quickly
* Ability to work directly and productively with customers — onboarding them, owning the relationship, and translating customer conversations into technical decisions.
* Curiosity of a product manager and discipline of a project manager: asks "why" before "how," scopes and sequences work, communicates status, and lands the work.
* Written and verbal communication sufficient to present complicated concepts to teammates, managers, and customers with the appropriate level of detail.


**Bonus**
* Prior experience in healthcare technology, digital health, or patient\-facing products.
* Hands\-on experience building production agentic systems, RAG pipelines, or MCP\-based tool integrations.
* Familiarity with HIPAA, HITRUST, or FedRAMP compliance considerations in builds.
* Experience with EHR integrations (Epic, athena, eClinicalWorks, NextGen) or call center / CCaaS integrations.
* Experience writing evals and quality benchmarks for LLM\-driven systems.

**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Product Engineer
   

  

**Salary**
 Not Disclosed
   

  

**Company Description**
 River is a $2M pre\-seed NYC startup building AI voice agents for B2B SaaS sales teams, backed by the founders of Ramp, Kalshi, and JumpCloud.
   

  

**Job Description**
 You will build River’s core product across the stack, focusing on the backend services powering live AI voice calls and browser\-automation demos. Working directly with founders, you’ll ship LLM workflows and enrichment pipelines that allow AI agents to qualify and close deals in real\-time, seeing your code live in sales calls within days.
   

  

**Location**
 New York, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Ship to production and watch your work drive real\-time sales calls the same week, offering immediate feedback loops and high impact.
* Work directly with founders at a $2M pre\-seed company backed by top\-tier operators from Ramp, Kalshi, and JumpCloud.
* Define a new category by building "Liv," an AI agent that goes beyond chat to actually control browsers and demo products autonomously.


**What You Will Do**
* Develop backend services and APIs using Node.js and TypeScript to manage live call sessions, state, and complex data integrations.
* Build and refine LLM\-powered workflows and prompts that guide the AI agent through live product demos and objection handling.
* Engineer the browser\-automation agent that navigates complex UIs in real\-time while the voice agent interacts with prospective buyers.


**The ideal candidate**
* Has 1–3\+ years of experience shipping real\-world software, with deep proficiency in TypeScript, Node.js, and modern React environments.
* Demonstrates hands\-on experience building applications with LLMs and possesses a strong product sense for how AI interactions should feel.
* Brings a background in voice, video, or real\-time infrastructure, specifically from a company specializing in voice or video AI applications.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.
   

  

 Give Jack a spin! You could land this role. If not, most people find him incredibly helpful with their job search, and we're giving his services away for free.

 We seek someone with a keen interest in aviation and technology, who loves to dig in to technical problems and work with a highly skilled team of engineers. You'll learn about aircraft systems and building advanced flight and mission simulators for commercial and military customers in a dynamic environment.
   

  

 We are currently searching for an Associate Software Engineer to join our team in Binghamton, NY. Employing some of the most talented dedicated people on the planet is not by chance. jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Security Platform
jobs.description:
**About Us**
 Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.
   

  

 We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X, and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the foundational software, data, and automation that enable security at scale across Twitch. As a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) on the Security Platform team, you will design, build, and operate critical services, pipelines, and tooling that power Twitch's security, privacy, and compliance programs.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Twitch Security Platform builds and operates the foundational software, data, and automation that enable security at scale across Twitch. As a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) on the Security Platform team, you will design, build, and operate critical services, pipelines, and tooling that power Twitch's security, privacy, and compliance programs.
   

  

 In this role, you will work at the intersection of software, security, privacy, and data engineering, contributing production systems that handle large\-scale security telemetry, automate security workflows, and provide reliable data and services to internal teams. You will partner closely with engineers and product teams to solve real\-world security problems through well\-designed software.
   

  

 You will own projects end\-to\-end from design and implementation through deployment and operational support for the systems that are business\-critical and highly visible. The problems you work on will span areas such as security data ingestion and processing, detection and response automation, service\-to\-service authentication, vulnerability management, and privacy engineering. This is a broad platform charter, and priorities shift as the security landscape does; you should be energized by a wide surface area and comfortable moving fluidly between systems rather than anchored to a single one.
   

  

 This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working in ambiguous problem spaces, values operational excellence, enables peers, and wants to see their work directly improve Twitch's security posture at scale.
   

  

 You can work from San Francisco, CA; Irvine, CA; or Seattle, WA.

* Partner across Security, Identity, Privacy, and Infrastructure on Twitch\-wide initiatives.
* Drive operational excellence: observability, reliability, and operational readiness for critical systems.
* Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, clear technical decision\-making and validation including AI\-assisted output.
* Participate in, retrospectives, and technical discussions, influencing decisions through technical leadership.

* A track record of leading technical projects that span multiple services and parallel workstreams
* Strong cross\-team communication able to disagree with data and commit once decided.


**Bonus Points**
* Full\-stack experience ownership across backend APIs and frontend experiences.
* Familiarity with security, data, and privacy systems, such as security or audit data lakes, cloud authentication and authorization flows, vulnerability scanning and remediation pipelines, and privacy or compliance\-driven workflows (e.g., CCPA, GDPR\-related controls).
* Experience working with large\-scale event or log data, including event\-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, or batch/streaming pipelines.
* Experience integrating AI\-assisted development or analysis tools into engineering workflows, such as using LLM\-powered tooling, automation, or MCP\-style platforms to improve developer productivity or system insight.
* Familiarity with Twitch, either as a viewer or creator (or both!)

jobs.title: Front-End Engineer, Amazon Connect (AWS)
jobs.description:
**Description**
 As part of the AWS Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day\-to\-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real\-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no\-brainers to buy and easy to use.
   

  

 Are you inspired to work with a team than launches products with direct and massive impact on Amazon’s customers? Are you excited to join one of the newest and most exciting AWS services?
   

  

 Amazon Connect is an AI\-powered customer experience solution that enables superior outcomes at a lower cost. Since its 2017 public launch, Amazon Connect has become an AI leader, transforming how organizations of all types interact with their customers.
   

  

 We have a rapidly growing customer base and an exciting charter in front of us that includes solving highly complex engineering and algorithmic problems. We are looking for passionate and talented Software Development Engineers to join us to innovate on this new service that addresses customer needs to build modern contact centers in the cloud. The position represents a rare opportunity to be a part of a fast\-growing business soon after launch, and help shape the technology and product as we grow. You will be playing a crucial role in developing the next generation contact center, and get the opportunity to design and deliver scaleable, resilient systems while maintaining a constant customer focus.
   

  

 As a Front End Engineer on our team, you’ll own code end\-to\-end from design to development, and work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. You’ll have a sound understanding of computer science fundamentals and practical industry experience, working across the stack with technology involving modern web, SOA, NoSQL databases, AI, ML, Big Data and more.
   

  

 This team is a great fit for you if
   

  

 You enjoy working with a fun team that prides itself on a great work environment with an inclusive group of people that are working together towards a common goal.
   

  

 You are sensitive to customer needs and interested in working on a service that will be used, directly and indirectly, by millions of customers and has a meaningful impact to their functions and interactions.
   

  

 You’d like to be directly responsible for solving real customer problems.
   

  

 You are a passionate learner and are motivated to take on new challenges.
   

  

 You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance.
   

  

 Learn more about Amazon Connect here.

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

 As a Front End Engineer on our team, you’ll own code end\-to\-end from design to development, and work closely with senior technical leaders within the team and across AWS. You’ll have a sound understanding of computer science fundamentals and practical industry experience, working across the stack with technology involving modern web application, NoSQL databases, AI, ML, Big Data and more.

 You want to have fun; surround yourself with a highly talented pool of engineers that like to solve complex problems, but also enjoy work life balance.
   

  

 A day in the life
   

  

* Participate in bi\-weekly sprint planning
* Attend daily standups with the team
* Attend weekly operational meeting, lunch n' learns, and career coaching 1 on 1's with your manager
* Communicate weekly on project statuses
* Schedule and participate in project meetings and reviews with UX, PM, and Engineering stakeholders
* Contribute feature code and conduct code reviews for your teammates
* Have Fun! Attend weekly team events to connect and build strong working relationships


**About The Team**
 ABOUT AWS:
   

  

 Diverse Experiences
   

  

 Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
   

  

 Why AWS
   

  

 Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
   

  

 Work/Life Balance
   

  

 We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
   

  

 Inclusive Team Culture
   

  

 Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
   

  

 Mentorship and Career Growth
   

  

 We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Preferred Qualifications**
